direction: Serious medieval RPG with readable Knight Online and RuneScape inspired silhouettes. Normal regions have mature neutral fantasy wildlife and thriving ecosystems; never cute mascots or blanket decay. Fairy regions use organic fantastical anatomy and vibrant alternate-reality colors. Wilderness permits stranger and darker forms. Stone creatures show natural geology and weathering. Horns are occasional, not a default. No science fiction or superhero faceplates. Wizard sets use pointed hats; lower-tier martial armor is simpler.

assets.prompt: Marchweave novice robes. Craftable tier 1 wizard clothing set. A classic soft broad-brim pointed wizard hat, slightly bent tip, plain blue wool band and one modest brass buckle. Blue-gray wool robe with comfortable narrow sleeves, warm cream linen lining, brown leather belt, plain leather gloves and ankle boots, dark trousers visible through split robe hem. Very simple low-level medieval village wizard, no armor plates, no huge shoulders, no gems. Presented as clothing worn by an invisible person, empty hat and collar, sleeves held in relaxed A-pose, no visible human body, no staff. Hand-painted wool weave, stitched seams, worn leather grain and small repaired patches. One single full-body asset, centered three-quarter front view, all limbs and feet separated and visible, plain warm gray background, no floor base, no lettering, no collage or additional views. Hand-painted classic medieval fantasy RPG art, soft natural rounded forms, earthy layered textured surfaces, readable game silhouette, efficient broad geometry. Absolutely no sci-fi, robots, Iron Man, superhero designs, angular faceplates, geometric visor eyes, mechanical joints, powered armor, glowing circuitry or chest reactors.
assets.reviewNotes: Pointed soft hat, restrained cloth silhouette, gloves and boots visible, no faceplate or large pauldrons. This is a design source, not a published inventory icon.
